title: Poincaré duality in Hida families
summary: We construct a bilinear pairing for $p$-adic families of cohomology classes associated to locally symmetric spaces of a certain level at $p$ and obtain a comparison between the specialisations of constructed pairing and the natural duality pairings on cohomology of automorphic sheaves under specialisation maps.
